name: createSlice()
description: The core Redux Toolkit function that generates a slice of the store — a reducer function plus its matching action creators — from a name, an initial state, and an object of reducer functions.
parameters: name — string prefix used to namespace generated action types. initialState — the slice's default state. reducers — object of case reducer functions. extraReducers — optional handlers for actions defined outside this slice.
returns: A slice object with `.reducer`, `.actions`, `.caseReducers`, and `.name` properties.
notes: createSlice is the standard, recommended way to write Redux logic today — it removes most of the boilerplate of hand-written action types, action creators, and switch statements.

name: Slice reducers use Immer
description: Reducer functions written inside createSlice's `reducers` field are run through Immer under the hood, so you can write code that looks like it mutates `state` directly (e.g. state.push(item)) while Immer safely produces an immutable update.
notes: You can still return a new state value explicitly instead of mutating draft state, but not both in the same case reducer.

name: extraReducers
description: A field on createSlice used to let a slice respond to actions that were defined elsewhere, such as action types from createAsyncThunk or actions from other slices.
parameters: builder — a builder object with addCase(), addMatcher(), and addDefaultCase() methods.
notes: Use extraReducers instead of `reducers` for any action type the slice itself doesn't define — this keeps action type strings unique.

name: slice.actions
description: The object of auto-generated action creators returned by createSlice, one for each key defined in the `reducers` field, typically destructured and exported.
returns: An object mapping each reducer name to its corresponding action creator function.
example:
export const { added, removed } = todosSlice.actions;
dispatch(added('Buy milk'));

name: slice.reducer
description: The combined reducer function generated by createSlice, handling both the slice's own actions and any extraReducers, ready to be passed into configureStore.

name: Slice naming convention
description: The `name` passed to createSlice namespaces every generated action type as '`name`/`reducerKey`' (e.g. 'todos/added'), which keeps action types unique across slices and readable in the Redux DevTools.
notes: Two slices with the same `name` will silently generate colliding action types — keep slice names unique per store.
